newsitem.title: USA: Court lifts injunction on Columbia/HCA deal.
newsitem.headline: Court lifts injunction on Columbia/HCA deal.

text.p: A Massachusetts court has lifted its preliminary injunction enjoining Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp's planned merger with Value Health, the company said Tuesday.
A Massachusetts Superior Court justice dissolved the preliminary injunction after a subsidiary of Value Health sold its stale in a partnership in the state, Columbia/HCA said in a statement.
Value Behavioral Health Inc sold its 50-percent interest in the Massachusetts Behavioral Health Partnership to its partner, FHC Options Inc, it said.
Last June, The court temporarily delayed the merger at the request of FHC Optionse.
FHC said the merger would hurt its partnership with the subsidiary to provide mental health services to Medicaid beneficiaries.
Columbia/HCA, a healthcare provider, said it expected the merger to close in July as soon as regulatory matters concerning the State of California Department of Corporations are resolved.
